local function SZFCN_fake_script() -- window.Dragify 
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', window)

    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    
    local gui = script.Parent
    
    local dragging
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPos
    
    local function update(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
    
    gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = gui.Position
    
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    
    gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            update(input)
        end
    end)
end
coroutine.wrap(SZFCN_fake_script)()

scripts.features:
MediaPlayer Gui (Only supported 'https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/')

Steps to get the videoUrl:
- Open discord.
- Upload the video you want ('.mp4').
- Once the video uploaded, hold/right click the video & click at 'Copy Media Link'/'Copy Link'.
- Then paste it into the MediaPlayer Gui.
(Sometimes, the videoUrl copied is not '.mp4', so you need play it on your device to check, is it showing video '.mp4' or not showing but only audio '.mp3 but saved as .mp4')
(The saving process are very slow & will lag your device)
(it takes some times to load the video into the playlist)

(If you delete your video file, make sure to click the button that you deleted in the MediaPlayer Gui, so it will removed the button too)

(The playlist are empty when you execute the script, so you need to upload your own videoUrl, the video saved in the local storage (folder: "MediaPlayer"))







Feel Free to use it, Open Source.
